description: Llama 3.2 is Meta's multimodal model family featuring both lightweight text models (1B, 3B) and vision-language models (11B, 90B). The vision models can understand images alongside text, while the smaller text models are optimized for edge and mobile deployment.

architecture.type: Auto-regressive Transformer with vision adapter for multimodal variants

trainingData.description: Text models trained on up to 9 trillion tokens via knowledge distillation from Llama 3.1. Vision models trained on 6B image-text pairs.

trainingProcedure: Text models use knowledge distillation from Llama 3.1 8B and 70B. Vision models use vision adapter with cross-attention layers integrated with Llama 3.1.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Strong performance for model sizes. Vision models excel at document understanding and visual QA. Text models optimized for on-device efficiency.

knownLimitations: Vision models: image+text in English only
EU restrictions on multimodal models (requires separate agreement)
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Smaller text models less capable than larger variants

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied during training.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: RLHF alignment and safety tuning applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local and edge deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

licenseTerms: Separate license required for >700M monthly active users
EU restriction: Separate agreement required for multimodal rights

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, edge deployment, or cloud deployment

hardware.1B: Can run on mobile devices and CPUs
hardware.3B: Can run on edge devices, ~6GB RAM
hardware.90B: High-end GPU required, ~180GB VRAM for full precision
